WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_dom BETWEEN 1 AND 2
      AND d_year IN (2000, 2000 + 1, 2000 + 2)
),
filtered_household_demographics AS (
    SELECT hd_demo_sk
    FROM household_demographics
    WHERE (hd_buy_potential = '1001-5000' OR hd_buy_potential = '5001-10000')
      AND hd_vehicle_count > 0
      AND hd_dep_count / hd_vehicle_count > 1
),
dj AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number,
           ss.ss_customer_sk,
           COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN filtered_date_dim AS dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    JOIN filtered_household_demographics AS hd ON ss.ss_hdemo_sk = hd.hd_demo_sk
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM store AS s
        WHERE s.s_store_sk = ss.ss_store_sk
          AND s.s_county = 'Williamson County'
    )
    GROUP BY ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_customer_sk
)
SELECT c.c_last_name,
       c.c_first_name,
       c.c_salutation,
       c.c_preferred_cust_flag,
       dj.ss_ticket_number,
       dj.cnt
FROM dj
JOIN customer AS c ON dj.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
WHERE dj.cnt BETWEEN 1 AND 5
ORDER BY dj.cnt DESC, c.c_last_name ASC
